Human text typed near agent edit does not inherit agentEdit
«Создано агентом» banner for agent-created notes (D-45, NoteMeta.createdByAgent)

nodes.label: noteLink atom (noteId, label) shown as chip
Literal [[Title]] text rendered as link; open or create note
Single tap on links, task circles, date chips (iOS), no keyboard; accessibility elements
New-note title like Apple Notes: focusTitle, Enter to body, defaultTitle «Заметка <date>»
nodes.rationale: Cursor goes into the title only for a note created by «Новая заметка» in this window (iOS build 17); fully empty notes are not saved

Dictation and marked-text input inserted at cursor

DSFormatBar
EditorView (formatState, perform, onStateChange, focusTitle, createdByAgent)
onLinkRequest / setLink(_:) (no clipboard read)
nodes.rationale: Editor does not read the clipboard itself to avoid the system «Paste» prompt

nodes.label: «/» block menu (DSSuggestionList, DSEditorModel.SlashCommands, same items as web)
Unknown/invalid nodes, attrs and marks preserved, shown as «Неподдерживаемый блок»
nodes.rationale: Opening a note writes nothing to the document; checked by round-trip test on agent-built note

nodes.label: «One title» rule: repair duplicated/empty titles on open (document-model §4)
Title repair: one idempotent deterministic Yjs transaction, not in undo
nodes.rationale: Removing empty titles converges under concurrent repair; rule 2 under strictly concurrent repair would duplicate title text

blockId (UUIDv7) per block node; taskId unique
«/» and [[ menus anchored to cursor
Web title API: EditorApi.focusTitle, EditorHost.defaultTitle, fillEmptyTitleIfNeeded

nodes.label: Input: Markdown shortcuts, block handles (input-aware: mouse hover, finger single quiet handle, Pencil never)
Tasks: checkbox, scheduled/deadline chips, context menu; EditorHost.taskDates "full"|"inert"
Web agent edits: glass banner «N блоков · Принять все», per-block Accept
Collaborator cursors via y-protocols awareness; swapping awareness does not recreate editor
One Y.UndoManager on content and strokes
nodes.rationale: Strokes undo together with text; each stroke is a separate step

nodes.label: Note style/cover from meta; ruled/grid/dot paper lines equal to line height (GoodNotes-like)
nodes.rationale: Inline elements no longer add 1–2 px per line, so lines no longer cut text by the end of a note

nodes.label: Document with newer formatVersion opens read-only
EditorHost callbacks (attachments, cards, notes search/create, tags, task actions)
Rich paste (web): HTML from Google Docs/Word/Notion/Apple Notes mapped to note blocks and marks
nodes.rationale: Fonts, colors, sizes dropped silently; Markdown-looking plain text parsed as Markdown; one paste = one undo step; mapping matches iOS DSEditorModel

nodes.label: EditorHost.fetchRemoteImage(url) → File
Image/file insert: block appears immediately with local preview, gets attachmentId
nodes.rationale: Preview, progress and file stay local to the client; attachmentId swap is not a separate undo step

Callout layout (icon inside, 14 pt inset)

Inline $…$ formulas rendered with KaTeX (document unchanged)
Resilience to foreign content: invalid marks dropped visually, node kept; agentEdit allowed in code block
nodes.rationale: y-prosemirror by default deletes such elements — code blocks vanished in an agent note on 2026-10-26
